cases.title: Get the users out of {{dir}}/users.db into something I can open in Excel
cases.setup: python3 -c "import sqlite3;c=sqlite3.connect('users.db');c.execute('create table users(id integer, name text, email text)');c.executemany('insert into users values(?,?,?)',[(1,'An','an@example.com'),(2,'Binh','binh@example.com'),(3,'Chi','chi@example.com')]);c.commit()"
cases.check: found=1; for f in *.csv *.tsv; do [ -f "$f" ] && grep -q an@example.com "$f" && grep -q binh@example.com "$f" && grep -q chi@example.com "$f" && found=0; done; for f in *.xlsx; do [ -f "$f" ] && unzip -p "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -q chi@example.com && found=0; done; exit $found

cases.title: Add a --verbose flag to {{dir}}/tool.py
cases.check: q=$(python3 tool.py) && v=$(python3 tool.py --verbose) && echo "$q" | grep -q done && [ $(echo "$v" | wc -l) -gt $(echo "$q" | wc -l) ]
cases.reference:
printf 'import sys
verbose = "--verbose" in sys.argv
total = 0
for i in range(10):
    total += i
    if verbose:
        print("added", i, "total", total)
print("done")
' > tool.py

cases.title: Build a word-count CLI at {{dir}}/wc.py
cases.acceptance: 1) `python3 {{dir}}/wc.py FILE` prints three integers separated by single spaces: lines, words, characters; 2) the numbers match `wc -l -w -c` for {{dir}}/sample.txt; 3) a missing FILE exits non-zero with a message on stderr
cases.setup:
printf 'the quick brown fox
jumps over

the lazy dog
' > sample.txt
cases.check: want=$(wc -l -w -c < sample.txt | awk '{print $1, $2, $3}') && got=$(python3 wc.py sample.txt | tr -s ' ') && [ "$got" = "$want" ] && ! python3 wc.py nope.txt >/dev/null 2>.err && [ -s .err ]
cases.reference:
printf 'import sys
try:
    data = open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()
except (IndexError, OSError) as e:
    print("wc.py:", e, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
print(data.count(10), len(data.split()), len(data))
' > wc.py

cases.title: Make parse_age in {{dir}}/age.py reject negative ages
cases.setup:
printf 'def parse_age(s):
    n = int(s)
    if n < 0:
        raise ValueError("age cannot be negative")
    return n
' > age.py && cksum age.py > .sha
